Includes NMA-issued texts, shipping subject classifications, vessel-title matches, four core maritime acts and their implementing instruments, instruments amending these, and change notes cited by selected consolidations.
coverage.limitations: Gazette texts are enactments and amendment notices, not historical consolidations. Current consolidated texts represent the archive snapshot; adoption year is not a version date. Gazette starts in 2001. Local regulations, other jurisdictions, third-party standards, embedded graphics and labelled appendices are outside this text extraction. Legal applicability requires reading the original scope and exceptions.
